Luna Nuova.pelle: Skin is sensitive and receptive — ideal for scrubs and deep cleansing.
Luna Nuova.capelli: Time for renewal: great for a new haircut or fresh look.
Luna Nuova.unghie: Try new colors, this is the right moment to be bold.
Luna Nuova.corpo: Start new habits and cleansing routines.

Crescente.pelle: Skin is primed to absorb: apply nourishing masks and serums.
Crescente.unghie: Trim to promote strong and healthy regrowth.
Crescente.corpo: High energy: start exercises and regenerating treatments.

Primo Quarto.capelli: Great for strengthening treatments and vivid colors.
Primo Quarto.unghie: Care for cuticles and moisturize hands.

Gibbosa Crescente.capelli: Avoid excessive washing — natural oil protects.
Gibbosa Crescente.corpo: Prepare the body for the full moon: rest and hydrate.

Luna Piena.pelle: Maximum permeability: ideal for intensive and anti-aging masks.
Luna Piena.unghie: Nails grow fast — reinforce and touch up color.

Gibbosa Calante.pelle: Eliminate impurities and dead skin cells.
Gibbosa Calante.capelli: Trim ends — the shape lasts longer.
Gibbosa Calante.unghie: Trim to maintain shape over time.

Ultimo Quarto.capelli: Excellent for lasting cuts and long-lasting dye.
Ultimo Quarto.unghie: Lasting shape: the trim holds longer.

Calante.corpo: Time for rest and deep energy recovery.

Luna Nuova.corpo: Vital energy low, body receptive. Great for light fasting, detox and new beginnings. Wounds heal more slowly — avoid procedures if possible.
Luna Nuova.natura: Sap descends to the roots: plant bulbs and roots. No pruning.
Luna Nuova.psiche: Natural introversion. The best time to set new intentions.

Crescente.corpo: Energy rises, the body absorbs nutrients and supplements better. Vitality and muscle strength increase.
Crescente.natura: Juices rise: plant fruit trees and flowers. Watering is more effective.
Crescente.psiche: Motivation and willpower grow. Face challenges with more drive.

Primo Quarto.corpo: Peak strength and endurance. Ideal for intense sport and active treatments. Circulatory system reactive.
Primo Quarto.natura: Sap in balanced upward movement. Good time for light pruning.
Primo Quarto.psiche: High decision-making energy. Resolve conflicts and push projects forward.

Gibbosa Crescente.corpo: Body retains water and substances. Watch for bloating. Maximum intestinal permeability: watch your diet.
Gibbosa Crescente.natura: Fruits at maximum turgidity. Quality harvest.
Gibbosa Crescente.psiche: Growing tension, busy mind. Slow down and integrate before the full moon.

Luna Piena.corpo: Maximum vital energy. Body fluids at peak: ideal for intensive treatments, but higher bleeding risk. Avoid dental extractions.
Luna Piena.natura: Avoid cuts and pruning: tissues are swollen with sap. Harvest ripe fruit.
Luna Piena.psiche: Emotions amplified, creativity high but also instability. Lighter sleep.

Gibbosa Calante.corpo: Body begins releasing toxins. Great for draining massages, detox treatments and long-lasting hair removal.
Gibbosa Calante.natura: Sap descends: effective pruning, cuts heal well.
Gibbosa Calante.psiche: Growing clarity. Eliminate what is no longer needed, physically and mentally.

Ultimo Quarto.corpo: Energy gradually declining. Deep detox, therapeutic fasting and rest are very effective.
Ultimo Quarto.natura: Work the soil, pull weeds. Roots hold better.
Ultimo Quarto.psiche: Balance and reflection. Close open cycles, make space for the new.

Calante.corpo: Metabolism at minimum, intense cellular regeneration during rest. Avoid surgery if possible.
Calante.natura: Soil at rest. Minimal plant activity, the ground regenerates.
Calante.psiche: Deep introversion. Meditation, silence and energy recovery.

Luna Nuova.semina: Avoid sowing — the earth is at rest. Prepare the soil, add compost.
Luna Nuova.potatura: Do not prune. Ideal day to clean tools and plan.
Luna Nuova.note: Day of pause: sap is at the roots, the soil regenerates.

Crescente.semina: Great for sowing fruit and leaf plants. Juices rise — germination is faster.
Crescente.potatura: Light formative pruning. Avoid important cuts.
Crescente.raccolta: Harvest aromatic and leafy plants — more intense flavor.
Crescente.note: Growth phase: everything you sow has extra momentum.

Primo Quarto.semina: Sow cereals, legumes and fruit plants. High growth energy.
Primo Quarto.potatura: Light pruning to stimulate lateral branches.
Primo Quarto.raccolta: Good harvest of fruits and cereals.
Primo Quarto.note: Sap in ascending balance — excellent for transplants.

Gibbosa Crescente.semina: Sow flowers and berry plants. Watering is more effective.
Gibbosa Crescente.raccolta: Excellent harvest of fruits at peak turgidity.
Gibbosa Crescente.note: Fruits at juicy peak: ideal for preserves and jams.

Luna Piena.semina: Avoid sowing — energy is dispersed. Focus on harvesting and preserving.
Luna Piena.potatura: Do not prune — tissues are swollen and the plant bleeds.
Luna Piena.raccolta: Harvest ripe fruits at aromatic peak. Excellent for wine and oil.
Luna Piena.note: Maximum energy charge: the harvesting day par excellence.

Gibbosa Calante.semina: Sow roots and bulbs: onion, garlic, potatoes.
Gibbosa Calante.potatura: Excellent pruning: cuts heal well, sap descends.
Gibbosa Calante.raccolta: Harvest roots and tubers. Great for drying herbs.

Ultimo Quarto.semina: Sow roots, bulbs and root plants. Excellent for fertilizing.
Ultimo Quarto.potatura: Main pruning: lasting shape, rapid healing.
Ultimo Quarto.raccolta: Harvest roots, potatoes and products to preserve.
Ultimo Quarto.note: Work the soil, pull weeds — roots won't regrow.

Calante.semina: Sow bulbs and roots. Avoid leaf plants.
Calante.raccolta: Harvest everything to be stored for a long time.
Calante.note: Earth at rest. Irrigation reduced to a minimum.

7.desc: Scorpio — Leaf. Medicinal herbs at peak. Sow slow-growing leaves.

8.desc: Sagittarius — Fruit. Grape harvest, olive picking, dried fruit. Excellent for wines.

9.desc: Capricorn — Root. Truffles, tubers, medicinal roots. Resistant pruning.

10.desc: Aquarius — Flower. Sow cut flowers. Good for bees and biodiversity.

11.desc: Pisces — Leaf. Sow lettuces and aquatic plants. Watch for fungi.

Brave, passionate, charismatic. Magnetic presence that inspires others. Competitive and unpredictable. Yang nature.
Calm, elegant, gentle, diplomatic. Sensitive to beauty, loves peace. Responsible and reflective. Yin nature.
Confident, enthusiastic, visionary. The most powerful in the Chinese zodiac. Generous and capable of great deeds. Yang nature.
Enigmatic, wise, intuitive. Thinks deeply before acting. Gifted with great inner intelligence. Yin nature.
Energetic, free-spirited, enthusiastic. Loves movement and adventure. Hard to tie down but loyal to loved ones. Yang nature.
Calm, creative, empathetic. Sensitive to art and nature. Prefers peace to conflict. Yin nature.
Sharp, curious, versatile. Solves problems with humor. Brilliant and unpredictable, adapts to anything. Yang nature.

Generous, compassionate, sincere. Loves life's pleasures. Naive but pure of heart, brings abundance. Yin nature.

tronchiInfo.desc: The first breath. Yang Wood: the oak, the force that pushes toward the light. Pioneering energy, creativity that does not bend.
Yin Wood: the climbing vine, the flexibility that wraps and finds its way. Grace, adaptation, silent tenacity.
Yang Fire: the sun. Generous warmth that illuminates everything without discrimination. Natural charisma, expansion, enthusiasm.
Yin Fire: a candle flame. Inner light, intuition, intimate warmth. Gentle guidance that orients without blinding.
Yang Earth: the mountain. Solidity, protection, absolute stability. An imposing presence that reassures and sustains.
Yin Earth: the fertile field. The capacity to nourish and contain, to receive and transform. Care, memory, rootedness.
Yang Metal: the sword. Determination, precision, the ability to cut the essential from the superfluous. Firm justice.
Yin Metal: the jewel. Refinement, beauty in perfection. Aesthetic sensitivity and the pursuit of absolute quality.
Yang Water: the ocean. Inexhaustible depth, boundless potential. The capacity to contain everything and move on a grand scale.
Yin Water: the dew, the subtle rain. Silent intuition, wisdom that slowly penetrates in depth.

elementiEssenza.legno:
Wood is expansion, growth, vision. It represents spring and awakening.

Yang aspect: ambition, creativity, initiative, generosity.
Yin aspect: rigidity, frustration, difficulty letting go.
elementiEssenza.fuoco:
Fire is transformation, joy, connection. It represents summer and the heart.

Yang aspect: charisma, enthusiasm, passion, clarity.
Yin aspect: anxiety, impulsiveness, overstimulation.
elementiEssenza.terra:
Earth is center, stability, nourishment. It represents the transitions between seasons.

Yang aspect: reliability, care, concreteness, groundedness.
Yin aspect: worry, rumination, difficulty changing.
elementiEssenza.metallo:
Metal is purity, structure, essentialness. It represents autumn and discernment.

Yang aspect: precision, integrity, inner strength.
Yin aspect: rigidity, melancholy, perfectionism.
elementiEssenza.acqua:
Water is depth, wisdom, flow. It represents winter and the source of all life.

Yang aspect: intuition, adaptability, intelligence.
Yin aspect: fear, isolation, stagnation.

stesso.desc: The day mirrors your essence. Familiar energy, strong sense of self and independence.
stesso.bene: Autonomous decisions, personal initiatives, reaffirming your own identity.
stesso.cura: Tendency to impose on others — balance with openness and listening.

nutrito.desc: The day nourishes and sustains you. The environment works for you: recovery and learning are facilitated.
nutrito.bene: Study, meditation, writing, reflection, gathering inner strength.
nutrito.cura: Can create passivity — act even when you already feel comfortable.

esprimo.desc: Your energy flows into the world. A creative day: what you express finds resonance.
esprimo.bene: Art, communication, teaching, performance, new projects.
esprimo.cura: Risk of dispersion — choose what to focus your creative energy on.

domino.desc: Your element dominates the day's energy. You are in a position of strength and practical clarity.
domino.bene: Business, negotiations, resource management, organization, acquisitions.
domino.cura: Excessive control can close opportunities — leave room for the unexpected.

sfidato.desc: The day challenges your nature. External structure, responsibility and constructive pressure.
sfidato.bene: Discipline, formal duties, growth under pressure, respect for rules.
sfidato.cura: Avoid unnecessary conflicts — use the tension as fuel to surpass your limits.
